correctness.rationale: The finite divisor catalogue lists all 56 exceptional classes and their exact integral pairings. Direct Gram and Geiser identities give eigenvalues and the exact matrix-tree determinant; fraction-free Bareiss exactly reproduces that determinant. Prime-power integer row and column reduction at 2, 3 and 7 gives all 55 Smith valuations in three deleted-vertex choices. Valuation totals equal the exact determinant and the reconstructed factors form a divisibility chain. verify.py directly rechecks every critical step, including the all-vertex distance-two graph relation. No computationally unproved infinite claim is needed because the graph is a uniform 56-curve configuration for every smooth degree-two del Pezzo surface over characteristic zero.

value.rationale: The 56 exceptional curves form the intrinsic degree-two del Pezzo configuration. Intersection exactly one is a canonical full geometric incidence stratum, not an arbitrary selected subset. Its complete integral critical group is a natural invariant strictly finer than the spectrum and spanning-tree number and distinguishes it from the zero-intersection Gosset graph. An exact global Smith classification supplies meaningful torsion information for geometric combinatorics and comparisons of degenerating graphs, without claiming a downstream theorem.
